घ: घ The fourth consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding to Gh.

घ m. (-घः) 	 1. A bell. 	 2. A rattling or gurgling sound. 	 f. (-घा) 	 1. A tin-kling ornament worn by women round the waist. 	 2. Strikling, kill-ing. 	 3. Wetting, sprinkling,  E. हन् to kill, affix ड, and घ substi-tuted for the radical letter, or the same affix, with घृ to sprinkle, &c.
घग्घ: घग्घ r. 1st cl. (घग्घति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride also; घघ and गग्घ.
घघ: घघ r. 1st cl. (घघति) To laugh or to laugh at: see the preceding.
घट: घट r. 1st cl. (घटते) To act, to strive or endeavour. r. 10th cl. (घाटयति) 1. To unite or to put together. 	 2. To injure or kill. 	 3. To shine (इ) घटि r. 10th cl. (घण्टयति) To shine. घट भ्वा-आ-अक-सेट् घटादि ।

घट m. (-टः) 	 1. A large earthen water jar. 	 2. The sign Aquarius. 	 3. A measure; see कुम्भ. 	 4. An elephant's frontal sinus. 	 5. Suspending the breath as a religious exercise. 	 6. A man who makes effort or exer-tion. 	 f. (-टा) 	 1. A troop of elephants assembled for martial purposes. 2. Effort, endeavour. 	 3. An assembly. 	 4. A number, a collection, an assemblage. 	 f. (-टी) 	 1. The Ghari or Indian clock, a plate of iron or mixed metal on which the hours are struck. 	 2. A small water jar, a ewer.  E. घट् to endeavour, &c. affix अच् or अङ् and fem. affix टाप् or ङीप्.
घटक: घटक m. (-कः) 	 1. A tree that produces fruit without apparent flowers. 2. A match-maker, an agent who ascertains or invents genealogies, and negociates matrimonial alliances. 	 3. A genealogist.  E. घट् to endeavour, and णिच् ण्वुल् aff.
घ टक m. (-कः) A rule, a doctrine.
घटग्रह: घटग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who or what takes a water pot.  E. घट and ग्रह् to take, अच् aff.
घटदासी: घटदासी f. (-सी) A bawd or procuress.  E. घट् effort, and दासी a slave or servant.
घटन: घटन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Effort, exertion. 	 2. Assembling, bringing together. 3. Joining, mixing. 	 4. Occuring.  E. घट् to strive, &c. affix युच् ।
घटयोनि: घटयोनि m. (-निः) The saint AGASTYA.  E. घट a water jar, and योनि place of birth; the saint being born from a water jar. see कुम्भसम्भव.
घटराज: घटराज m. (-जः) A large water jar of baked clay.  E. घट् a jar, and राज king, chief. घटेन योजनेन राजते राज-अच् ।
घटस्थापन: घटस्थापन n. (-नं) Placing a water pot as a type of DURGA, an essential part of various Tantrika ceremonies.  E. घट, and स्थापन placing.
घटाटोप: घटाटोप m. (-पः) A covering for a carriage or any article of furniture. E. घट and आटोप pride.
घटिक: घटिक n. (-कं) The posteriors. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. The ankle; also घटिका. 	 2. A Muhurta or thirtieth part of a day and night. 	 3. A Danda or period of twenty-four minutes. 	 m. (-कः) A waterman.  E. घटी a clock. &c. affixes कन् and टाप् for the feminine; otherwise घट a jar and ठन् aff.
घटित: घटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Devised, attempted. 	 2. Made of. 	 3. In contact with, contiguous, joined.  E. घट् to make effort, णिच् क्त aff.
घटिन्धम: घटिन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Who blows or sounds in a jar. 	 m. (-मः) A potter E. घटी and ध्मा to blow, खश् aff. मुम् ह्रस्वश्च ।
घटिन्धय: घटिन्धय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who drinks a Ghati, (in measure.)  E. घटी and घै to drink, खश् aff. मुम् ह्रस्वश्च ।
घटीकार: घटीकार m. (-रः) A potter.  E. घट कार who makes, with अण् aff.
घटीग्रह: घटीग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who or what takes a small jar, &c.  E. घटी and ग्रह who takes. अच् aff.
घटीयन्त्र: घटीयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) The rope and bucket of a well, or any machine for rais-ing water.  E. घट effort, and यन्त्र machine.
घटोत्कच: घटोत्कच m. (-चः) The son of BHIMA by the Rakshasi, named HIDIMBA.
घटोत्कचान्तक: घटोत्कचान्तक m. (-कः) A name of KARNA, natural brother to the Pandus E. घटोत्कच a proper name, and अन्तक destroyer.
घटोद्भव: घटोद्भव m. (-वः) The sage AGASTYA.  E. घट a jar, and उद्भव born, produced.
घट्ट: घट्ट r. 1st and 10th cls. (घट्टते or घट्टयति-ते) To move. With परि prefixed, To spread or diffuse. With वि, To rub gently, to scratch. भ्वा-आत्म-सक-सेट् । वा चुरा-उभ० ।

घट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A Ghat, a quay or landing place, steps on the side of a river, &c. leading to the water's edge. 	 f. (ट्टी) A small or inferior landing place, private stairs, &c.  E. घट्ट् to go, affix घञ् and with ङीष् affix, implying diminution.
घट्टना: घट्टना f. (-ना) 	 1. Going, moving. 	 2. Practice, business, means of living. 3. Rubbing or striking together.  E. घट्ट् to go, affix युच् fem. टाप्.
घट्टजीविन्: घट्टजीविन् m. (-वी) An attendant at a landing place, who takes care of the clothes of the bathers, &c.  E. घट्ट, and जीविन् who subsists. णिन् ।
घण: घण (उ,) घणु r. 8th cl. (घणुति or घणुते) To shine. तना-उभ-अक सेट् ।
घण्ट: घण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A sort of sauce, vegetables made into a pulp with water, turmeric, mustard seeds and capsicums. 	 f. (-ण्टा) 	 1. A bell; also a plate of iron or mixed metal struck as a bell. 	 2. A plant: see घण्टापाटली  E. घन to strike, क्त affix, fem. टाप् and deriv. irr.
घण्टाक: घण्टाक m. (-कः) A plant: see घण्टा पाटली  E. कन् added to the preceding; some copies read घण्टीक and घाण्टीक.
घण्टाकर्ण: घण्टाकर्ण m. (-र्णः) One of SIVA'S attendants, and is worshipped to pre-side over cutaneous complaints, and is worshipped for exemption from them in the month Chaitra.  E. घण्टा, and कर्ण and ear; having ears as broad as a bell.
घण्टाताड: घण्टाताड m. (-डः) A bell-man, one who strikes a bell or Ghadi.  E. घण्टा, and ताड who beats.
घण्टाताडन: घण्टाताडन n. (-नं) Striking a bell.  E. घण्टा, and ताडन beating.
घण्टानाद: घण्टानाद m. (-दः) The sound of a bell, &c.  E. घण्टा, and नाद sound.
घण्टापथ: घण्टापथ m. (-थः) The chief road through a village, a highway.  E. घण्टा a bell, and पथि a road, affix अच्; the bell-road, or that by which elephants, &c. decorated with tinkling ornaments, proceed.
घण्टापाटली: घण्टापाटली f. (-ली) A plant commonly called by the similar name Ghan-taparuli, a species of the trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. घण्टा a bell, &c. and पाटली the trumpet flower.
घण्टावाद्य: घण्टावाद्य n. (-द्यं) The sound of a clock.  E. घण्टा and वाद्य playing.
घण्टावीज: घण्टावीज n. (-जं) The croton nut.  E. घण्टा, and वीज seed.
घण्टारवा: घण्टारवा f. (-वा) Crotolaria of various species.  E. घण्टा, and रव sound; the seed rattling within the husk.
घण्टाशब्द: घण्टाशब्द m. (-ब्दं) 	 1. Bell-metal. 	 2. The sound of a bell.  E. घण्टा, and शब्द sound.
घण्टास्वन: घण्टास्वन m. (-नः) The sound of a bell or clock.  E. घण्टा, and स्वन sound.
घण्टिका: घण्टिका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate.  E. घण्टा a bell, and कन् affix of similitude.
घण्टु: घण्टु m. (-ण्टुः) 	 1. A string of bells tied on an elephant's chest, &c. by way of ornament. 	 2. Heat, light, &c.  E. घटि to shine, Unadi affix उन् ।
घण्टेश्वर: घण्टेश्वर m. (-रः) A minor deity, the son of MARS.  E. घण्टा, and ईश्वर lord.
घण्ड: घण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A bee.  E. घण वा-ड तस्य नेत्त्वम् । भ्रमरे ।
घन: घन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Material, solid. 	 2. Coarse, gross. 	 3. Compact. 	 4. Hard, firm. 	 5. Full, plum. 	 6. Impenetrable. 	 7. Vicid, thick, inspis-sated. 	 8. Deep, (as sound) 	 9. Very, much. 	 10. Auspicious, fortu-nate. 	 11. Permanent, eternal. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A cloud. 	 2. An iron club. 3. The body. 	 4. A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 	 5. A num-ber, an assemblage or quantity. 	 6. Extension, diffusion. 	 7. Hard-ness. 	 8. Solidity, substance. matter. 	 9. The cube of a number, (in arithmetic.) 	 10. A solid, (in geometry.) 	 11. Phlegm. 	 12. Talc. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. A cymbal, a bell, a Gong, &c. any brazen or composite metallic instrument, which is struck as a clock, &c. 	 2. A mode of dancing, neither quick nor slow. 	 3. Iron. 	 4. Skin, rind, bark, &c. E. हन् to strike or be struck, affix अप् and ह changed to घ.
घनकफ: घनकफ m. (-फः) Hail.  E. घन a cloud, and कफ phlegm.
घनकाल: घनकाल m. (-लः) The rainy season.  E. घन a cloud, and काल time.
घनगोलक: घनगोलक m. (-कः) An alloy of gold and silver.
घनघनौघ: घनघनौघ m. (-घः) A gathering of dark clouds.  E. घन thick, close, घनौघ cumulus.
घनचय: घनचय m. (-यः) A collection of clouds, cumulus  E. घन, and चय a heap.
घनजम्वाल: घनजम्वाल m. (-लः) A quantity of mire, a slough.  E. घन much, a heap, and जम्वाल mud.
घनजाल: घनजाल n. (-लं) A gathering of clouds.  E. घन, and जाल multitude.
घनज्वाला: घनज्वाला f. (-ला) Lightning, a flash of lightning.  E. घन a cloud, and ज्वाला flame.
घनताल: घनताल mf. (-लः-ला) A bird: see घनतोल. घनतायां निविडतायाम् अलति पर्य्या-प्नोति अल्-अच् ।
घनतिमिर: घनतिमिर n. (-रं) 	 1. The darkness of clouds. 	 2. Great darkness.  E. घन, and तिमिर dark.
घनत्व: घनत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Firmness, compactness. 	 2. Thickness, coarseness, solidity.  E. त्व added to घन; also with तल्, घनता.
घनतोल: घनतोल mf. (-लः-ला) The Chataka, (Cuculus melanolencos.)  E. घन a cloud, and तुल् to be equal, घनं मेघं तोलयति ऊर्द्ध्वं नयति आह्वानेन । तुल-उन्मितौ अण् उपमित समासः । who soars to the clouds in the rainy sea-son, which, according to the fable, is the only time when he gets water to drink; some books have घनताल from ताल tune, or sound; whose music is (from) the clouds.
घनध्वनि: घनध्वनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Roaring, who or what makes such a sound. m. (-निः) 	 1. A deep and loud tone, a roar. 	 2. The muttering of thunder clouds.  E. घन and ध्वनि sound.
घननाभि: घननाभि m. (-भिः) Smoke.  E. घन a cloud, and नाभि the navel or centre; smoke being supposed to be a principal ingredient in clouds. घनस्य मेघस्य नाभिरिव योनित्वात् । धूमे ।
घननीहार: घननीहार m. (-रः) Thick falling frost or snow.  E. घन, and नीहार hoar-frost.
घनपदवी: घनपदवी f. (-वी) The sky.  E. घन a cloud, and पदवी station.
घनपयोधर: घनपयोधर m. (-रः) A firm breast.  E. घन, and पयोधर the female breast.
घनपल्लव: घनपल्लव m. (-वः) A plant, (Hyperanthera; morunga:) see शोभाञ्जन  E. घन abundance, and पल्लव a shoot or sprout. घना निविडाः पल्लवा अस्य.
घनपाषण्ड: घनपाषण्ड mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डा) A peacock.  E. घन a cloud, and पाषण्ड a sectary; this bird is supposed to delight in cloudy and rainy weather. घनेन मेघध्वनिना पाषण्ड इव उन्मत्तत्वात् । मयूरे ।
घनफल: घनफल m. (-लः) The contents of a solid, (in Geometry.)  E. घन and फल fruit. घनानि निविडानि फलानि अस्य । विकङ्कटवृक्षे च ।
घनमूल: घनमूल n. (-लं) Cube root, (in Arithmetic.)  E. घन and मूल root. घनस्य समत्रिघातस्य मूलमाद्यम् ।
घनरव: घनरव m. (-वः) The roaring of clouds, thunder.  E. घन and रव sound.
घनरस: घनरस mn. (-सः-सं) Water. 	 m. (-सः) 	 1. Camphor. 	 2. Extract, decoction, &c. 	 3. A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.) 	 4. Thick or inspissated juice.  E. घन a cloud or a heap, and रस juice, essence. घनस्य मेघस्य मुस्नकस्य वा रसो निष्यन्दः ।
घनवर्त्म: घनवर्त्म n. (-र्त्म) The sky.  E. घन and वर्त्मन् path.
घनवल्लिका: घनवल्लिका f. (-का) Lightning.  E. घन a cloud, and वल्लिका a creeper. घना निविडा वल्ली यस्याः कप् ह्रस्वः ।
घनवल्ली: घनवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Lightning.  E. घन and वल्ली a creeper. घनस्य मेघस्य वल्लीव । विद्यु ति ।
घनवात: घनवात m. (-तः) One of the regions of hell.  E. घन much, and वात wind; the region of storm. घनो निविडो वातोऽत्र ।
घनवास: घनवास m. (-सः) A pumpkin gourd.  E. घन a long time, and वास abiding. घनो वासो गन्धोऽस्य कुष्माण्डे ।
घनवाहन: घनवाहन m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. A name of INDRA.  E. घन a cloud and वाहन a vehicle; who rides in the clouds. घन इव शुभ्रं वाहनमस्य । शिवे । घनो मेघो वाहनमस्य । इन्द्रे वा ।
घनवीथि: घनवीथि f. (-थिः) A line of clouds.  E. घन and वीथि a row. घनानां वीथिः ।
घनशब्द: घनशब्द m. (-ब्दः) The noise of clouds, thunder.  E. घन and शब्द sound.
घनश्याम: घनश्याम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Black, deep black, as that of heavy clouds m. (-मः) 	 1. RAMA. 	 2. KRISHNA.  E. घन and श्याम black. घनः मेघ इव श्यामः ।
घनसंवृत्ति: घनसंवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Profound secrecy.  E. घन impenetrable, संवृत्ति secret purpose.
घनस्वन: घनस्वन m. (-नः) Low thunder, the muttering of clouds.  E. घन, and स्वन sound. घनेन तज्जलेन सुष्ठु अनिति अन्-अच् तृती-तत्पुरुषः । तण्डुलीयशाके । मेघध्वनौच ।
घनसमय: घनसमय m. (-यः) The rainy season.  E. घन a cloud, समय time.
घनसार: घनसार m. (-रः) 	 1. Camphor. 	 2. Mercury, or some peculiar form of it. 	 3. Water. 	 4. A kind of tree.  E. घन firm, &c. and सार essence. घनस्य मुस्त-कस्य सारः ।
घनाकर: घनाकर m. (-रः) The rainy season.  E. घन a cloud, and आकर a mine or place of producing. घनानामाकरः घनान् आकिरति आ + कॄ अच् वा । वर्षाकाले ।
घनाघन: घनाघन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Mischievous, cruel. 	 2. Even, uniform, with-out spaces or interstices. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of INDRA. 	 2. A vici-ous elephant, or one in rut. 	 3. A rainy cloud. 	 4. Mutual collision. f. (-ना) A vegetable, (Solanum Indicum;) also काकमाची.  E. घन as above, reiterated and the final of the first made long. हन-अच् निपातने ।
घनात्यय: घनात्यय m. (-यः) The season succeeding the rains, autumn.  E. घन a cloud and अत्यय disappearance, departure. घनानामत्ययोऽत्र । शरत्काले ।
घनान्त: घनान्त n. (-न्तं) Autumn, the end of the rains.  E. घन a cloud, and अन्त end.
घनामय: घनामय m. (-यः) The date tree, (Elate sylvestris.)  E. घन a cloud, and आमय sickness, pining in the rains. घनो दृढः आमयो यस्मात् ।
घनामल: घनामल m. (-लः) A kind of potherb, (Chenopodium album:) see वास्तूक. E. घन much, and अमल clear, clean.
घनाम्बु: घनाम्बु n. (-म्बु) Rain.  E. घन, and अम्बु water.
घनारुण: घनारुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Deep red.  E. घन, and अरुण red.
घनारुद्ध: घनारुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Overcast, overspread with clouds.  E. घन, and आरुद्ध obstructed.
घनावरुद्ध: घनावरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Overcast, overspread with clouds.  E. घन, and अवरुद्ध impeded.
घनाश्रय: घनाश्रय m. (-यः) Æther, the atmosphere or heaven.  E. घन a cloud, and आश्रय asylum.
घनीकृत: घनीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Hardened, compacted, made solid or firm. 	 2. Congealed, thickened.  E. घन and कृत made, with च्वि augment.
घनोदधि: घनोदधि m. (-धिः) A division of hell.  E. घन viscid, and उदधि an ocean.
घनोपल: घनोपल m. (-लः) Hail.  E. घन a cloud, and उपल a stone.
घनोपरुद्ध: घनोपरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Clouded, overcast.  E. घन and उपरुद्ध obstructed.
घनौघ: घनौघ m. (-घः) A gathering of clouds.  E. घन, and ओघ a heap.
घम्ब: घम्ब r. 1st. cl. (घम्बति) To go to move. गतौ भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।

Ghee, clarified butter, or butter which has been boiled gently, and allowed to cool: it is then used for culinary and religious purpose and is highly esteemed by the Hindus. 	 2. Water. 	 f. (-ता) The name of a tree: see घृतमण्डा.  E. घृ to sprinkle Unadi affix क्त.
घृतकुमारी: घृतकुमारी f. (-री) The aloe, (Aloes perfoliata)  E. घृत ghee, to which the extact is compared, and कुमारी a virgin, which the plant is sup-posed to resemble in delicacy and elegance; also घृतकुमारिका. घुतमिव कुमारी सुन्दरी ।
घृतकुम्भ: घृतकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A jar of ghee.  E. घृत and कुम्भ a jar.
घृतदीधिति: घृतदीधिति m. (-तिः) The deity of fire.  E. घृत ghee, and दीधिति light; of-ferings to fire, always comprehending clarified butter.
घृतपशु: घृतपशु m. (-शुः) Ghee made into or supposed to resemble an animal to be offered at a sacrifice or eaten at a meal, for which it is substi-tuted.  E. घृत, and पशु an animal.
घृतपूर: घृतपूर m. (-रः) A sweetmeat composed of flour, milk, cocoanut and ghee, &c.  E. घृत ghee, and पूर what is full of.
घृतपूर्णक: घृतपूर्णक m. (-कः) A tree. (Caledupa arborea, &c.) see करञ्ज  E. घृत ghee, and पूर्ण full, कप् added.
घृतप्राश: घृतप्राश m. (-शः) Swallowing ghee.  E. घृत and प्राश eating.
घृतप्राशन: घृतप्राशन n. (-नं) Tasting or swallowing ghee.  E. घृत and प्राश eating.
घृतप्लुत: घृतप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sprinkled or smeared with ghee,.  E. घृत, and प्लुत bathed.
घृतमण्डा: घृतमण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A tree; also वायसोली.  E. घृत, and मण्ड scum; the scum of its infusion resembling ghee.
घृतलोलीकृत: घृतलोलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed with ghee, steeped in it or wet with it, &c.  E. घृत लोल desirous. कृत made, च्वि augment.
घृतवर: घृतवर m. (-रः) A sweetmeat, or flour, &c. baked with ghee, and sugar. E. घृत and वर what excels.
घृतविक्रयिन्: घृतविक्रयिन् m. (-यी) A vender of ghee.  E. घृत विक्रय to sell, इनि aff.
घृतस्पृश्: घृतस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Who or what touches ghee.  E. घृत स्पृश to touch, क्विन् aff.
घृताक्त: घृताक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Smeared with ghee.  E. घृत and अक्त smeared.
घृताची: घृताची f. (-ची) One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Swarga.  E. घृत ghee, अञ्च to worship, क्विप् and ङीप् affs.
घृताचीगर्भसम्भवा: घृताचीगर्भसम्भवा f. (-वा) Large cardamoms.  E. घृताची गर्भ the womb, and सम्भव born from.
घृताभ्यक्त: घृताभ्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Smeared or anointed with ghee.  E. घृत and अभ्यक्त anointed.
घृताह्व: घृताह्व m. (-ह्वः) Turpentine.  E. घृत ghee, and आह्वा and appellation, named from ghee.
घृतेली: घृतेली f. (-ली) A cock-roach.  E. घृत ghee. इल् to go, अच् affix, र changed to ल fem. affix ङीष् । घृते स्नेहद्रव्ये इलति शेते इल शाये-अच् गौरा-ङीष् । (तेलापोका) ।
घृतोद: घृतोद m. (-दः) The sea of ghee surrounding Kusa Dwipa.  E. घृत and उद water. घृतमिव स्वादु उदकमस्य । उदकस्य उदः ।
घृतोदङ्क: घृतोदङ्कः m. (-ङ्कः) A leather vessel holding ghee.  E. घृत उद up, अञ्च् to go, affix घञ्.
घृतोदङ्कः: घृतोदङ्कः m. (-ङ्कः) A leather vessel holding ghee.  E. घृत उद up, अञ्च् to go, affix घञ्.
घृष: घृष (उ) घृषु r. 1st cl. (घर्षति) To grind or pound. सक-पर-सेट् ।
घृष्ट: घृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Ground, rubbed, pounded. 	 2. Frayed, grazed, rubbed off.  E. घृष् to rub, कर्मणि क्त aff.
घृष्टि: घृष्टि mf. (-ष्टिः) A hog; also गृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. A plant, commonly Varaha-cranti, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) 	 2. Grinding, pounding. 	 3. Emulation, contest.  E. घृष् to grind, affix कर्त्तरि क्तिच्.
घृष्टिला: घृष्टिला f. (ला) A plant: see पृश्निपर्णी  E. घृष्टिं लाति लाक घर्षति भूमिं तुण्डेन ।
घृष्वि: घृष्वि mf. (-ष्विः-ष्वी) A hog.  E. घृष् to rub, Unadi affix क्विन् घर्षति भूमिं तुण्डेन ।
घेञ्चलिका: घेञ्चलिका f. (-का) An esculent root, (Arum orinense.)
घोट: घोट m. (-टः) a horse: see the next.
घोटक: घोटक m. (-कः) A horse. 	 f. (-टिका) A mare.  E. घुट to strike again, (to spurn the ground,) अच् and कन् ण्वुल् वा affixes, or without the latter affix घोट.
घोणा: घोणा f. (णा) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. The nose or nostrils of a horse.  E. घुण् to roll, to turn, and अच् and टाप् affs.
घोणिन्: घोणिन् m. (-णी) A hog.  E. घोणा nose or snout, and इनि aff.
घोण्टा: घोण्टा f. (-ण्ठा) 	 1. The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) 	 2. The betelnut tree: see गुवाक. 	 3. A timber tree, (Schrebera swietenioides.)  E. घुट् to resist, affix अच् and नुम् inserted or घुण वा ट ।
घोनस: घोन[ण्]स m. (-सः) A large kind of snake.  E. घो for गो a cow, and नस a nose. see गोनस according to others the word is घोणस, from घुण् to roll, and असच् aff.
घोर: घोर r. 1st cl. (घोरति) To go as a horse.

घोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Frightful, horrible, terrific. 	 m. (-रः) A name of SHIVA. 	 f. (-रा) Night. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Horror, horribleness. 	 2. Poison. E. घुर् to be frightful, affix अच or गुर् substituted for हन् to injure or kill, and अच् Unadi aff.
घोरदर्शन: घोरदर्शन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Terrific, of horrid or frightful appearance. 	 m. (-नः) An owl.  E. घोर as above, and दर्शन sight.
घोरपुष्प: घोरपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Bellmetal.  E. घोर and पुष्प a flower.
घोररासन: घोररासन m. (-नः) A jackal.  E. घोर frightful, and रासन cry or sound, from रास् to sound, affix ल्युट.
घोररासिन्: घोररासिन् m. (-सी) A jackal. E. See the last, णिनि aff.
घोररूप: घोररूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Frightful, hideous. 	 n. (-पं) A hideous. appearance. E. घोर and रूप form.
घोररूपिन्: घोररूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Frightful, horrible, hideous.  E. घोररूप and णिनि aff.
घोरसङ्काश: घोरसङ्काश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Dreadful, horrible.  E. घोर, and सङ्काश like.
घोराकृति: घोराकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Frightful, hideous, of horrible aspect or form.  E. घोर, and आकृति form.
घोल: घोल n. (-लं) Buttelmilk.  E. घुड substituted for हन् to strike, (i. e. with the churn,) and घञ् affix, ड changed to ल.
घोष: घोष m. (-षः) 	 1. A station of herdsmen. 	 2. A herdsman. 	 3. A creeping plant, commonly called by the same name Ghosha, and bearing white or yellow flowers, (Luffa pentandra and acutangula.) 	 4. Bellmetal, tutenague, &c. 	 5. Low thunder or the muttering of clouds. 	 6. Sound. 	 7. A proclamation. 	 8. A gnat, a musquito 9. A term proper for the name of a Kayastha. 	 f. (-षा) A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa:) see मधुरिका.  E. घुषि to shine, to sound, &c. affix. आधारे घञ्.
घोषक: घोषक m. (-कः) 	 1. A cryer, a proclaimer. 	 2. Ghosha, described as a cree-king plant, (Luffa pentangula, &c.)  E. कन् added to the preceding.
घोषकाकृति: घोषकाकृति f. (-तिः) A plant commonly called Hatighosha, and perhaps a species of the preceding.  E. घोषक Ghosha, and आकृति shape, ap-appearance of similar appearance.
घोषण: घोषण nf. (-णं-णा) 	 1. Speaking loud, making a great noise. 	 2. Crying, proclaiming.  E. घुष् to sound, affixes णिच् भावे ल्युट् and टाप्.
घोषयित्नु: घोषयित्नु m. (-त्नुः) 	 1. A Brahman. 	 2. The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 	 3. A captive. 	 5. A cryer, a herald.  E. घोष sound, इत्नुच् affix, and य inserted.
घोषवती: घोषवती f. (-ती) A lute, a Vina.  E. घोष sound, and मतुप् poss. aff.
घौर: घौर n. (-रं) Horror, horribleness.  E. घोर and अण् aff.
घ्नत्: घ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नत्-घ्नन्ती-घ्नत्) Striking, beating, hurting.  E. हन् to strike, &c. शतृ aff.
घ्रति: घ्रति f. (-तिः) The nose.  E. घ्रा to smell, डति aff.
घ्रा: घ्रा r. 1st cl. (जिघ्रति) To smell, to receive smell.
घ्राण: घ्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Smelled. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. Smell, odour. 	 3. Smelling.  E. घ्रा to smell, करणे ल्युट् ।
घ्राणतर्पण: घ्राणतर्पण m. (-णः) Fragrance, odour, a fragrance, a perfume.  E. घ्राण the smell, and तर्पण what satisfies.
घ्राणदुःखदा: घ्राणदुःखदा f. (-दा) Sneezing.  E. घ्राण, and दुःखदा paining.
घ्रात: घ्रात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smelled.  E. घ्रा to smell, affix क्त.
घ्रात्वा: घ्रात्वा ind. Having smelled.  E. घ्रा to smell, क्त्वाच् aff.
घ्राति: घ्राति f. (-तिः) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. Smelling.  E. घ्रा and करणे क्तिन् aff.
